steps.content: One ferocious sandworm prostrates obediently before Stargazer, as if welcoming her return.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Are you happy for "it" too? The two "hearts" lost to the mortal world are finally back.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: But... there are constantly pesky people in the way. What can be done?
Stargazer asks this in a teasing tone, squinting her eyes. It is a rhetorical question, practically a taunt.
A few black shadows reappear from her crystal ball, severing the only path between Stargazer and the rest of you.
For a split second, you feel as if you're dreaming a nightmare.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hey! Give the Ash Crystals back! They're ours! Damn, what the **** are those black things! How dare they block my path!

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Haha... it's true they don't belong to me, but they are certainly not yours.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: It, they, and of course, me... we all belong to WhiteSands... to the Dreamflower. Filthflower? What a horrible slur that tarnishes its real name...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: I've been waiting for this moment ever since you set foot in WhiteSands.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: So you've been deceiving us from the beginning?!

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: "Deceive"...? We each took what we needed from each other.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: I needed the Ash Crystals held by you and the desert bandits. You needed me to help you defeat the desert bandits. It's a win-win...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Now it is time for me to collect my payment.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Farewell. It is time to end this ridiculous game of companionship.
Stargazer hops on a sandworm and departs before your eyes.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Yeah I heard you... but these shadows... how the **** do we get rid of them?!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, the more we struggle and fight, the more fiercely these dark shadows attack and bind us.
Upon hearing Hecate's description, you sense that these dark shadows bear a striking similarity to that mysterious, horrific entity.
If these shadows are also powered by sensing the emotions of the target...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Order Hecate and Hella to stand down

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Hecate, Hella, stop your attacks.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Now, focus on thinking about what we want to do! We want to go forward and find Stargazer!
The dark shadows halt their attacks when you stop to think. They remain frozen in place, then begin to dash in one direction as if suddenly injected with consciousness!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Let's follow.
You pilot the sand ship hot on the shadows' tails and soon catch up to Stargazer.
A furious Hella grabs a water pipe and throws it at Stargazer...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Come down, you witch!

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Ah... you remembered what I told you well, Chief... seems like you're really into me...
Stargazer recalls the dark shadows into the crystal ball and gazes at you with amusement.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Why are you doing this? Is it because you don't trust us enough?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: We won't harm any creature in WhiteSands, nor do we seek to conquer it. As soon as the Tide of Ashes is gone and trade across WhiteSands returns to normal, we will leave.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: No, Chief. I approached you simply for the Ash Crystals.
You don't understand. After she helped you in the Tide of Ashes, and your heart-to-heart talk under the moonlight... Is it still not enough for you to be her companion?

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Haha... still don't get it? Ever since "it" saved me, I knew I belonged to WhiteSands... to this other world.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: As for mankind? An identity built upon a world of lies is naturally also a lie.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If everything you did was just for the Ash Crystals, then why did you save me?

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: I don't know... maybe out of... amusement?

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Because for me, whether I want to save or kill someone, it's only a split second decision.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: You really don't want to become my companion?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It doesn't matter whether I'm your true choice or not.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The important thing is... though we may not have the same goal, we can benefit from the same end result.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Yet what you are doing now is clearly...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Betrayal? Haha... you think this is betrayal?

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: No matter who you make a deal with, there's a gamble you must take, my good Chief.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: You should've looked closely to see if I'm a good sword to use, or a... double-edged sword.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Moreover, my dear Chief, this isn't betrayal. It's revenge.
Stargazer enunciates the word "revenge" in an eerily calm tone.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Humanity must pay the price for what they did to WhiteSands and the Dreamflower.
Before you can ponder the meaning of these words, Stargazer speaks again.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Chief, remember when you promised that you would do something for me?

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: How about this. You promise to do one thing for me, and I'll agree to this "deal."

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: I'll tell you what you need to do later. Don't be nervous, it's nothing difficult.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I remember. You also said you won't make it difficult for me.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: That's right. Now it's time to make good on that promise. Leave and go back to DisCity.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Learn to accept parting ways. Give up your pursuit of the unknown. Go now and leave it be.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Although you always want me to stay, this time... you can't use any more tricks to make me.
A sudden gust of sand begins to swirl around Stargazer. You instinctively step forward to pursue her, but your companions pull you back.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, Stargazer summoned the Tide of Ashes. We don't have any Ash Crystals. You mustn't make any risky moves.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Moreover...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: If we chase her, we have to fight these sandworms first!
